arguments:
set -Eeuo pipefail
export GIT_PAGER=cat PAGER=cat GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
tmp="$(mktemp -d /tmp/rea-plcodex-cwd-published.XXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
git clone --quiet --depth 2 --branch fix/codex-worker-private-cwd-20261031 https://github.com/martaxi-boss/Project-leader-codex.git "$tmp/repo"
cd "$tmp/repo"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = 48d19832cfc44f47605f62e1cb1cab60864ab174
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD^)" = c39ee2add4862e902d6fb9c0ac6bfaa1d867a6ed
python3 - <<'PY'
import hashlib,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
expected={
"codex/dual.py":"56ce220f8a852f1c0d7d03e3bee17b6dd16c7bde944e5df14468e74ef66f4763",
"codex/tests/test_smart.py":"c9f1cda7b115993b3d616d90ecdf1cc38b3b628fb7c4e3823f1d86ad7ea293a1"
}
for path,sha in expected.items():
 got=hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
 assert got==sha,("TESTED_BYTES_MISMATCH",path,got)
 print("PUBLISHED_MATCHES_REA_TESTED_SHA256",path,flush=True)
changed=subprocess.check_output(["git","diff","--name-only","HEAD^","HEAD"],text=True).splitlines()
assert set(changed)==set(expected),changed

PY
git diff --check HEAD^ HEAD
python3 -m unittest codex.tests.test_smart.SmartRunTests.test_codex_cli_child_starts_inside_independent_writable_clone -q
